chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Soehan, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Muhammad ibn Sama'a, from a man, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
"Zakat is not purified from camels, cattle, and sheep except that which has had the year pass over it; and that which has not had the year pass over it is as if it did not exist."

key_terms.الْحَوْلُ: The passage of a full lunar year, a condition for zakat obligation
key_terms.يُزَكَّى: Is purified (referring to the payment of zakat)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition of hawl for zakat on livestock in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the temporal condition of 'hawl' for zakat on livestock, establishing that the obligation attaches only after a full lunar year has passed over the specific herd. It underscores the principle that partial years do not trigger liability, treating uncompleted periods as if the zakat duty has not yet attached, a ruling consistent with the majority of Shia jurists.
